verdict.rationale: Attio documents a public JSON-over-HTTPS REST API with a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec, filtering and sorting, documented 429/Retry-After rate-limit behaviour, and signed outbound webhooks. Together these let scripts and pipelines drive the workspace headlessly without the UI. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline usage guidance, documented API-key or service-account auth for unattended scripts (tokens appear only in the SDK context and an OAuth-flow heading), any CLI usable for CI automation beyond SDK migration, and independent hands-on corroboration.
